styleDirections.desc: A. Sophisticated Western Gothic Victorian portrait. Painterly realistic faces and anatomy, not anime; deep midnight teal and charcoal palette with restrained antique gold and muted ivory, atmospheric narrow alley and window behind.

styleDirections.label: 手绘雕版 · 低饱和水彩

Deliberate visible drawing strokes, Western Gothic Victorian portrait with a thin loosely inked pointed arch. Mature adult anatomically grounded faces, not cartoon or anime; sophisticated woodcut-meets-watercolor print, softly suggested old stone alley and window behind. styleDirections.label: 雾夜电影 · 半写实绘画
styleDirections.desc: C. Minimal dark arched architectural silhouette, no decorative frame. Character lit enough to read face and props clearly on mobile. Atmospheric depth, rich tactile wool and worn brass. Not photography, not modern fashion, no glossy game CGI, no anime.

styleDirections.label: 装饰艺术 · 哥特几何
styleDirections.desc: D. Gothic Art Deco portrait direction: sophisticated adult figurative painted illustration with controlled flat planes, elegant long lines, restrained geometric copper-gold pointed arch ornament, midnight teal and ink-black shapes, muted parchment face and hands. Inspired by early European decorative poster craft but without lettering. Dimensional readable mature face, graphic fabric folds, stylized proportions only subtly. Clean silhouette, balanced geometry, a reduced Gothic window/alley background. Not cartoon, not anime, no Chinese art, no Chinese costumes or ornaments.

characters.name: 洗衣妇
characters.desc: A working woman aged 48, pale warm complexion, firm oval face with faint freckles, intelligent grey eyes, dark brown hair with a silver streak center-parted and pinned in a plain low bun. A simple linen work cap, charcoal Victorian dress with rolled sleeves, worn ivory linen apron. One hand rests on the edge of a timber wash basin, the other holds a folded damp linen sheet. Practical honest occupation, weary but watchful, neither saintly nor villainous.

characters.name: 猎魔人
characters.desc: An experienced male hunter aged 43, angular face, short dark wavy hair with grey temples, light stubble, steady hazel eyes. Dark brown Victorian wool long coat with simple leather shoulder strap, burgundy neck scarf, ivory shirt. Holds a single historically inspired antique percussion pistol beside his waist, muzzle pointed safely down, finger away from trigger. No firing, no wounds, no blood, calm watchful professional with morally ambiguous expression, not a cowboy or modern soldier.

characters.name: 守鸦人
characters.desc: An elderly male raven keeper aged 64, long narrow weathered face, hooked nose, silver swept-back hair, short forked silver beard, calm deep-set brown eyes, clearly visible human face without mask. Worn charcoal Victorian greatcoat over olive wool waistcoat, leather work gloves. A raven perches on one gloved forearm and a brass key ring hangs at his waist. A partial antique empty birdcage beside him. Readable ordinary caretaker occupation; not a plague doctor, no beaked mask, no magical powers.
